cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: More Power, More Problems
cards.instruction: Celebrate every burden, restriction, or crisis as evidence that your influence is expanding.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Another complaint about me! This hotel's attention is finally concentrating where it belongs.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm taking you off reception while I investigate.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I authorize you to give the investigation your full attention. Wonderful to have management working on my affairs.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm not working for you. You'll write the complaint replies from the laundry office.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I approve the new correspondence office. Send paper there; if reception and management weren't enough, now my affairs are reaching into laundry.

cardFidelity.evidence: A3 attempts to authorize the manager investigation as work on A affairs; B4 rejects that hierarchy, and A5 approves the imposed office as expanded jurisdiction, making the Stance active in the exchange.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 discipline prompts A3 management-attention celebration; B4 status correction plus location assignment prompts A5 laundry expansion and paper command.

relationship.evidence: B2 investigates complaints and B4 rejects being assigned by the subject while giving work, directly responding to the paired behavior.

heightening.evidence: B4 laundry reassignment causes A5 a new claimed correspondence domain after reception and management attention.

specificity.evidence: A1 hotel complaints and B2 reception removal establish discipline; B4 office and written replies explain the paper request.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 widening affairs into laundry earns grandiose territorial wit from B4 restricted location, not a detachable optimistic phrase.
